responsibility: This definition module declares the higher-level meta-diagnostic formatter used by mc’s semantic analysis. Its API accepts nodes, names, and cardinals as operands and expands embedded mini-format directives into symbol names, qualified names, type names, declaration/use locations, counts, and warning/error modes, providing a reusable interface for precise semantic messages without hard-coding string assembly in every parser action.
same_name_distinction: This .def file publishes the template-driven semantic-diagnostic API of mcMetaError, declaring the metaError/metaErrors entry points and their formatting language contract; mcMetaError.mod contains the parser and expansion logic for those templates.
